info.title: WindowsToLinux internal Web API
info.description: Phase 5 only. Fixed server-owned internal user/workspace. Loopback, same-origin and explicit headers are not authentication. Never expose publicly. Resource views contain metadata and encrypted references only. Lists are bounded to 1000. Task kinds have closed input schemas; deploy overrides use shared typed field IDs. No shell or client-provided task state is accepted.

Decision.description: Exact shape depends on the persisted prompt. SECRET accepts only an encrypted secretId. INPUTS accepts only requested field IDs. No raw secret may be answered here.

result.description: Structured result for the submitted kind; never raw SSH output or credentials.
